paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA, presented in relation to the s_pop frequency, which ranges from 1 x10^4 to 19 x10^4 with tick labels spaced by 2 x10^4. The y-axis represents accuracy, with values ranging from approximately 0.3 to 1.0, marked with linear intervals. A blue dashed line with plus markers represents the accuracy, starting at approximately 0.34 at s_pop frequency of 1 x10^4 and decreasing to approximately 0.72 at s_pop frequency of 15 x10^4, with a sharp rise to approximately 0.83 at s_pop frequency of 17 x10^4. A black solid line with square markers represents the frequency, starting at 1 x10^4 and increasing to 19 x10^4 with a linear scale. A green solid line with circle markers represents the frequency, starting at approximately 0.5 at s_pop frequency of 1 x10^4 and ending at approximately 0.8 at s_pop frequency of 19 x10^4.
